audit.why: Difficulty 7.5/10 with a 52.56% win rate over 763 games reads as a genuinely tricky but winnable lane; the level chart matches the already-audited mirror (rumble__yorick.json) row for row, so no chart flips were proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] wrote 'His Equalizer' and gave no cooldown for either ultimate.
audit.why: Riot's name is The Equalizer, cd 130/105/80. Yorick's Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100. The 130s rank-1 number is what makes 'cage him only when R is down' actionable.
audit.corrected: The Equalizer is 130s at rank 1 — cage him after it is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole matchup is built around 'track Scrap Shield, bait it, then commit'. Scrap Shield is a flat 6-second cooldown — it cannot meaningfully be baited. Separately, spikes[0] called Scrap Shield a poke tool (it is a shield plus a speed burst) and told you to 'farm at max Q range' when Last Rites is range 0, a melee auto-attack empower.
audit.why: Rumble's real punishable state is Overheat: at 100% Heat from Junkyard Titan he cannot cast any spell at all. Flamespitter's 10/9/8/7/6s and the 600-range cone are the other windows. The ranged poke is Electro Harpoon (850 range, 2 charges, MR shred), not Scrap Shield.
audit.corrected: Commit during Overheat when he cannot cast, or on Flamespitter's down time. Mourning Mist (E, 700 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) marks him so Mist Walkers sprint at him; Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) cuts the retreat.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Scrap Shield as the matchup-defining cooldown.
audit.why: A 6s shield is not a window. Overheat and Flamespitter are.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to Overheat and Flamespitter's 10s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Rumble's Flamespitter (Q) and Scrap Shield poke shred you and your ghouls from range before you can commit. His heat-boosted Q melts your swarm and you at once. Farm with Q from max range and don't walk into his flame cone.
edits.after: Rumble's Flamespitter (Q) and Electro Harpoon (E) shred you and your ghouls from range before you can commit. Danger-Zone Q melts your swarm and you at once. Last Rites is melee — last-hit from outside his 600-range cone.

edits.before: His Equalizer (R) ultimate zones you off the wave and can catch you in cage, dealing heavy damage over time. Cage him only when his R is down. Use your R to hold a sidelane he can't zone.
edits.after: The Equalizer (R) zones you off the wave and can burn you inside your own Dark Procession. It is 130s at rank 1 — cage him only after it is spent, and use Eulogy to hold a sidelane he can't zone.

edits.before: Rumble out-pokes you and your ghouls with heated Flamespitter, shredding your swarm before you commit. Farm at max Q range, avoid his flame cone, and wait for overheat windows. He controls the opening lane.
edits.after: Rumble out-pokes you and the pack with Danger-Zone Flamespitter, shredding Mist Walkers before you commit. Last Rites is melee, so last-hit from outside his 600 cone and wait for Overheat. He controls the opening lane.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Rumble so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Raise 3-4 Mist Walkers, Mourning Mist (E) him so they sprint in, Dark Procession his retreat, and AA with the swarm.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Scrap Shield is a flat 6s cooldown — you cannot bait it. Commit on Overheat, when he cannot cast at all, or on Flamespitter's 10s down time. - Eulogy: kill windows only, 160s at rank 1.
